requirements.statement: A user can sign in so their todos are kept private to them

criteria.must: An unauthenticated user is prompted to sign in before seeing any todos
After signing in, the user reaches their own todo list
One user's todos are never visible to a different signed-in user

requirements.statement: A user can create a todo item to capture a task

criteria.must: A signed-in user can enter text and create a new todo
A newly created todo starts as incomplete

requirements.statement: A created todo is saved so it is not lost on reload

criteria.must: A created todo persists to the database and is still present after the page is reloaded

requirements.statement: A user can see the list of todos they've created

criteria.must: The todo list screen shows every todo the signed-in user has created

requirements.statement: A user can mark a todo as complete to track progress

criteria.must: A signed-in user can mark an incomplete todo as complete
A completed todo is visibly distinguished from an incomplete one on the list
